name: Shamrock Racing Tyres
description: Unleashing Irish innovation onto the world's racetracks.
story: Shamrock Racing Tyres was founded by a group of motorsport enthusiasts in County Cork, dedicated to developing high-performance tires specifically for competitive racing. With a strong focus on durability and grip, Shamrock seeks to partner with teams that demonstrate a similar commitment to excellence and a desire to push the boundaries of performance. They value innovation, dedication, and a winning spirit.
